record.name: Klaviyo
record.one_liner: A marketing automation platform offering email, SMS, and data-driven customer communication tools via robust APIs.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate API keys or set up OAuth apps directly from their settings.
record.api_note: Covers profiles, campaigns, flows, lists, segments, catalogs, coupons, metrics, and more.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth
Create apps and integrations using Klaviyo's API that help your business grow. Get started for free.
All /api endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes to authenticate requests.
The Klaviyo MCP server connects compatible AI clients to Klaviyo APIs through Model Context Protocol (MCP).
